releases.title: Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle  Overview  The Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle states that you cannot precisely measure both the position and momentum of a particle at the same time.  The more accurately you know one, the less accurately you know the other.  ⸻  Formula  Δx · Δp ≥ ħ / 2   ⸻  Key Points 	•	Δx = uncertainty in position 	•	Δp = uncertainty in momentum 	•	ħ = reduced Planck constant  ⸻  Example  # Conceptual example position_accuracy = "high" momentum_accuracy = "low"   ⸻  Summary Table  Quantity	Meaning Δx	Position uncertainty Δp	Momentum uncertainty   ⸻  Final Thought  This principle shows that uncertainty is not due to measurement error, but a fundamental property of nature.

purchases.summary:

In this episode of Share Your Bitcoin Journey, Bitcoin For The Arts founder Dion Wilson sits down with Sara about leaving the old streaming economy. She tells the story of earning a million sats in a single acoustic set, from people in the room and people watching online. purchases.title: Bitbrand: Bitcoin Saved My Life
purchases.summary:

purchases.title: Lady Nakamoto: From the X Games to Bitcoin Art
purchases.summary:

purchases.title: James Kintore: Materials-First Path from Sydney to Sound Money
purchases.summary:
Australian interior designer James Kintore — founder of Kintore Design and co-creator of Mat and Kin — on materiality, the time chain, and designing for things that last.
From rural South Australia to high-end Sydney residential work, then a 2025 move to Costa Rica to rebuild on a Bitcoin standard. We talk the 250-year-old French oak, the 2020 money-printer awakening, why Bitcoin is "an energy agreement," HNW clients and the Australian dollar, and why AI raises the value of real human creation.
